_note: FORMAT EXAMPLE ONLY. The LIVE manifest the app fetches is generated by .github/workflows/android-release.yml from android/release-notes.json and attached to the published GitHub Release, served via https://github.com/dhlbmhsn357-wq/-/releases/latest/download/update.json (and proxied same-origin at /update.json → /api/update with CORS). The app reads: versionCode (the only update trigger), apkUrl (https, direct download), sha256 (verified natively before install), versionName, mandatory, notes (array of short lines — the update window shows THESE, per release). A non-https apkUrl or a non-64-hex sha256 is rejected.
